heading.title: Relations of Partners to One Another

article.title: Duty to indemnify for loss caused by fraud.
article.content: Everypartner shall indemnify the firm for any loss caused to it by his fraud in the conduct of the business of the firm.
article.html:
10Duty to indemnify for loss caused by fraud.

Section 10 · Chapter III · page 5 of the Act

Everypartner shall indemnify the firm for any loss caused to it by his fraud in the conduct of the business of the firm.
